adoption: Optional; consuming projects opt in and verify their own layout.

pdf.placement: Centered below the deeper of the two reading columns.
pdf.tight_page_action: Omit ornament; retain content and pagination.
pdf.validation: Record actual bounds; check text clearance, footer reserve and overlap after pagination.
pdf.other_formats: Adapt explicit profile to trim size or single-column frame; these values are not universal.

web.placement: At the end of a section in natural document flow.
web.accessible_text: Empty alternative text; do not use the motif as a heading, link label or information-bearing illustration.
web.layout: Reserve intrinsic dimensions and constrain to available width. No absolute positioning over content.
web.validation: Review responsive spacing and reading order in the consuming page.

rights.instructions: Retain attribution and license; indicate modifications and share adaptations under the same license. Keep detailed generation provenance internal.
